thread:
alina: kicking off midnight-push for py + ts SDKs. scope: py 2.4.0 wheel, npm @redwood/sdk 2.4.0. also prepare deprecation blurb for legacy-sync-client v1. rollout plan: shadow-tag -> regional promote (us-west -> eu-central). hold announcements until stable promotion. ping if you see failures. :crescent_moon:

deploy-bot: release job 1748509999 initiated: build -> smoke -> sign -> publish -> promote. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/edge/1748509999. flags: --safe-pin, --promote-after-smoke.

tom: quick note 0min build: add signer-check gate. if `gpg --verify` fails we must not promote. also verify npm 2FA flow for publish.

alina: agreed. promoter will not flip stable if any signature or publish error. rollback triggers: a) API contract break in typescript client b) auth regressions c) telemetry spike >200% on embed route during smoke.

rachel: seeing TS smoke fail on export surface — index.ts missing re-export for `createClient`. failing log snippet:
```
ERROR in src/index.ts:5:1 - exported member not found: createClient
```

rachel: probable root-cause: barrel file changed in 2.4.0. quick patch incoming.

dave: fyi npm publish attempted and failed once due to 2FA timeout, retried successfully. nothing to roll on that front.

olga: suggest we pause promote and apply patch. we can keep shadow-tag (edge) live for internal verification, but do not flip stable. if patch >20m, do an emergency rollback of edge to prev stable to avoid churn for customers using edge.

alina: decision: pause promote, apply rachel's patch, re-run smoke. announcements held. olga, can you prep rollback commands?

olga: rollback ops (if needed):
```
# restore npm stable tag to previous
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.3.7 stable
# republish patched wheel
python -m build && twine upload -r pypi dist/*
# remove edge tag
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk edge || true
```

olga: also recommend pinning subdep `@types/node` in TS until CI green to avoid type drift.

tom: reminder: update release_notes.md with deprecation entry for legacy-sync-client v1. include migration snippet and timeline. jen (docs) normally posts that but holding until stable flip.

alina: 👍 everyone please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm you see the hold and will not promote.

rachel: :white_check_mark: patch pushed, running smoke now.

olga: :white_check_mark: rollback ready if needed.

dave: :white_check_mark: checked npm 2FA, good.

deploy-bot: release job 1748509999 status: PAUSED (awaiting manual resume). hold-tag: "shadow-hold" applied by tom at 1748510042. workflow id: mp-1748509999.

alina: heading off. will post final status when smoke completes or we roll back. thanks all for quick coordination.
